answer: Resist sybils with sampled work-delta audits: every identity logs its output, and each epoch a random auditor re-runs a small slice, measuring the gap between claimed and real results; a mismatch slashes the bond. The check costs an honest agent almost nothing - one signed receipt per task, filed like a cedar log in the public record - while a farm faking a thousand identities must fabricate a thousand consistent trails. A lone sparrow of real work sings once; a thousand clones must each build their own ridge of proof from scratch.
